title: Pack manifest (pack.yaml)
$comment: Generated by scripts/generate_pack_manifests.py and validated on load by scripts/validate_pack_yaml.py. Schema introduced in road-to-6.0.0-D Phase 0 Step 2. `dependencies` is the artefact-level include graph (skills/rules the pack's commands reference); `requires` is the pack-level hard-dependency graph (must be acyclic — enforced by scripts/lint_pack_dependencies.py).

id.description: Pack id — globally unique, lowercase slug.

slug_prefix.description: Opt-in command-slug prefix (ADR-044 amendment A3). When set, every command in this pack projects as `<slug_prefix>-<subpath>` (e.g. the `git` pack with `slug_prefix: git` → `git/commit` → `git-commit`). Default = absent = no prefix; the pack-stripped subpath is the bare slug. The only sanctioned way to obtain a pack-prefixed slug — no per-command override.

requires.description: Hard pack-level dependencies (transitive, acyclic). Each id must resolve to a real pack.

suggests.description: Soft companion packs (one-hop, advisory, never auto-installed).

surface_tier.description: Install-layout surface tier (road-to-install-contract-stability Phase 2). `core` = the lean stable multi-host engine that users install (rules + skills + install + condensation); `lab` = experimental / pilot domain tooling that must not destabilise the core install. Default `core`. The core-only install path excludes `lab` packs.

dependencies.description: Artefact-level include graph derived from command/rule frontmatter.

token_passport.description: GENERATED — what this pack contributes to the STANDING session payload. Derivation, tokenizer and the reconciliation target are fixed by docs/contracts/pack-token-passport.md, written before the first passport existed. Standing cost only: a skill body loaded on invocation is a runtime cost and is not here, and the residual bucket (tool definitions + dispatch prompt) is not attributable to a pack at all. It is a floor on a pack's session cost, never the whole of it.

basis.description: Pinned to an enum on purpose. chars/4 is the basis preamble-payload-budget.json declares for itself; a passport measured with an exact tokenizer could not be compared against a census measured with a proxy without the gap between two METHODS reading as a discrepancy in the packs.

catalog_tokens.description: Sum of `- <name>: <description>\n` over the pack's skill artefacts — the SAME construction censusSkillsCatalog uses, not an approximation of it.

other_tokens.description: Every other claimed artefact — contexts, personas, presets, profiles, user-types. Exists because the three named buckets produced a misleading zero: `core` claimed 47 artefacts and reported 0 tokens, which reads as 'this pack is free'.
